title: Connect Google Merchant Center
excerpt: Connect Google Merchant Center and confirm FeedOps has the right account access.
author: FeedOps
content:
Connect Google Merchant Center when you want FeedOps to manage product feed workflows for Google.

## Requirements

- A Google account with access to the Merchant Center account.
- Permission to manage product data and feeds.
- The correct Merchant Center account ID.

## Steps

- Open Connections in FeedOps.
- Select Google Merchant Center.
- Sign in with Google.
- Choose the correct Merchant Center account.
- Confirm FeedOps can read and manage product data.
